description: H1: is the CBG steroid pocket under stronger purifying selection than the rest of the protein?
code:
"""
H1: If the primary function of SERPINA6 is high-affinity steroid transport, the 15
cortisol-contact residues derived from PDB 4C49 should be MORE conserved across vertebrate
CBG orthologs than the rest of the mature chain, while the reactive centre loop (a
protease-recognition element) should NOT be. Falsifiable either way.
"""
import requests, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

url = ("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:SERPINA6+AND+reviewed:true"
       "&format=json&size=100&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence")
res = requests.get(url, timeout=120).json()["results"]
seqs = {f'{r["primaryAccession"]}|{r["organism"]["scientificName"]}': r["sequence"]["value"] for r in res}
HUM=[k for k in seqs if k.startswith("P08185")][0]; human=seqs[HUM]; OFF=22

B="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ln=B.strip().split("\n"); cols=ln[0].split(); M62={}
for r_ in ln[1:]:
    p=r_.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return M62.get((a,b),-4)

def nw(s1,s2,gap=-8):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    S=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); S[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; S[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap
    T=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); T[0,1:]=2; T[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pr,cu=S[i-1],S[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=pr[j-1]+sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1]); u=pr[j]+gap; l=cu[j-1]+gap
            if d>=u and d>=l: cu[j]=d; T[i,j]=0
            elif u>=l: cu[j]=u; T[i,j]=1
            else: cu[j]=l; T[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; a=[];b=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        t=T[i,j]
        if t==0: a.append(s1[i-1]); b.append(s2[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif t==1: a.append(s1[i-1]); b.append('-'); i-=1
        else: a.append('-'); b.append(s2[j-1]); j-=1
    return "".join(a[::-1]), "".join(b[::-1])

others=[k for k in seqs if k!=HUM]
ident=np.zeros(len(human)); cov=np.zeros(len(human)); pid={}
for k in others:
    a1,a2=nw(human,seqs[k]); hi=0; mt=0; al=0
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-':
            if c2!='-':
                cov[hi]+=1; al+=1
                if c1==c2: ident[hi]+=1; mt+=1
            hi+=1
    pid[k]=100*mt/al
cons=np.where(cov>0, ident/np.maximum(cov,1), 0)*100
print(f"{len(others)} vertebrate CBG orthologs aligned to human P08185")
for k,v in sorted(pid.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]): print(f"   {k:44s} {v:5.1f}% identity")

def P(m): return m+OFF-1
POCKET=[18,19,22,26,232,240,242,260,263,264,267,366,367,368,371]
CORE4=[232,264,368,371]; RCL=list(range(327,352)); NGLYC=[9,74,154,238,308,347]; VARS=[93,367]
pocket_c=np.array([cons[P(r)] for r in POCKET]); rcl_c=np.array([cons[P(r)] for r in RCL])
bg=cons[OFF:]
bg_np=np.array([cons[P(r)] for r in range(1,len(human)-OFF+1) if r not in POCKET and not 327<=r<=351])

print(f"\nBackground (mature chain, n={len(bg)}):  mean {bg.mean():.1f}%  median {np.median(bg):.1f}%")
print(f"Steroid pocket (n=15):                  mean {pocket_c.mean():.1f}%  median {np.median(pocket_c):.1f}%")
print(f"  UniProt core 4 (Q232,N264,H368,W371): {[f'{human[P(r)]}{r}:{cons[P(r)]:.0f}%' for r in CORE4]}")
print(f"RCL 327-351 (n={len(rcl_c)}):                 mean {rcl_c.mean():.1f}%  median {np.median(rcl_c):.1f}%")

u1,p1=stats.mannwhitneyu(pocket_c,bg_np,alternative='greater')
u2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(rcl_c,bg_np,alternative='less')
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=rng.choice(bg,size=(200000,15)).mean(1); p_perm=(null>=pocket_c.mean()).mean()
def cd(a,b):
    g=sum(x>y for x in a for y in b); l=sum(x<y for x in a for y in b); return (g-l)/(len(a)*len(b))
print(f"\nPocket > background: U={u1:.0f}, p={p1:.2e}, Cliff's d={cd(pocket_c,bg_np):+.3f}")
print(f"RCL  < background:   U={u2:.0f}, p={p2:.2e}, Cliff's d={cd(rcl_c,bg_np):+.3f}")
print(f"Permutation (200k random 15-mers): observed {pocket_c.mean():.1f}% vs null {null.mean():.1f}%, p={p_perm:.2e}")
print(f"\nFully invariant pocket residues across all {len(others)} orthologs (incl. Xenopus):",
      [f"{human[P(r)]}{r}" for r in POCKET if cons[P(r)]==100])
print("N-glycan sequon conservation:", {f"N{r}":round(cons[P(r)]) for r in NGLYC})
print("Disease-variant positions:", {f"{human[P(r)]}{r}":round(cons[P(r)]) for r in VARS})
print("Elastase site V344/T345:", {f"{human[P(r)]}{r}":round(cons[P(r)]) for r in (344,345)})

fig,(axA,axB)=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.8),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.5,1]})
axA.plot(np.arange(1,len(human)-OFF+1), bg, lw=0.7, color='#95a5a6')
axA.axhline(bg.mean(), ls='--', c='k', lw=0.9, label=f'mature-chain mean ({bg.mean():.0f}%)')
axA.axvspan(327,351,color='#f39c12',alpha=0.25,label='reactive centre loop 327-351')
axA.scatter(POCKET,[cons[P(r)] for r in POCKET],s=62,color='#2980b9',zorder=5,label='steroid-pocket contacts')
for r in VARS:
    axA.scatter([r],[cons[P(r)]],s=120,facecolor='none',edgecolor='#c0392b',lw=2,zorder=6)
    axA.annotate(f'{human[P(r)]}{r}',(r,cons[P(r)]),xytext=(0,-17),textcoords='offset points',
                 ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#c0392b')
axA.set_ylabel("Identity to human (%)"); axA.set_xlabel("Residue, mature human CBG")
axA.set_ylim(-5,108); axA.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc='lower left',ncol=2,frameon=False)
axA.set_title("The CBG steroid pocket is conserved across 11 vertebrate orthologs; the reactive centre loop is not")
parts=[pocket_c,bg_np,rcl_c]
bp=axB.boxplot(parts,labels=[f'Steroid pocket\n(n=15)',f'Background\n(n={len(bg_np)})',f'RCL\n(n={len(rcl_c)})'],
               widths=0.5,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for pt,c in zip(bp['boxes'],['#2980b9','#bdc3c7','#f39c12']): pt.set_facecolor(c); pt.set_alpha(0.65)
for i,arr in enumerate(parts,1):
    axB.scatter(np.random.default_rng(1).normal(i,0.055,len(arr)),arr,s=9,color='k',alpha=0.35,zorder=3)
axB.set_ylabel("Identity to human (%)")
axB.set_title(f"pocket vs background p={p1:.1e} (Mann-Whitney);  RCL vs background p={p2:.1e}",fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
